# Security Policy

## Access Control

All users must authenticate using multi-factor authentication (MFA) before
accessing any system resource.

Access to systems and data shall be granted based on the principle of
least privilege using role-based access controls (RBAC).

## Data Protection

All sensitive data stored in databases and file systems must be encrypted
at rest using AES-256 or equivalent encryption standards.

All data transmitted over networks must be encrypted in transit using
TLS 1.2 or higher.

## Incident Response

Security incidents must be reported within 24 hours of discovery.
